Abdul Aziz builds software that solves real problems. Focus: eCommerce, AI tools, and automation. Tech: React, Node, Laravel, Shopify, system design, multi-agent systems. Work spans eCommerce, fintech, marketplaces, and enterprise web systems.

This site is a static portfolio (not job-seeking). Content is in YAML; rendered client-side with vanilla JS (ES modules). Sections: hero, profile snapshot, about, how I work, experience, skills, projects, education, FAQ, contact.
